title: Ekoo fenaande
intro: Jokkondiral leñol jarribaama e ɓeydagol njiimaandi. Feere sirlu ƴettaa, ina jokki e ƴellitde jokkere enɗam, jogornde yuɓɓinde duuɓi, taƴde diƴƴe mawɗe. Golle ndee fedde ngaddi seertude e sunaare mawnde, kono daartol ngol joofnaani ɗoon. Ko haala fenaande, nimsa, e udditgol timmungol peeje Alla. Mbele aɗa waawi ƴellitde sifaa ɓeeɗoo yimɓe ɓe cuɓagol mum en ƴellitii e nder yontaaji ?
clues: Min ñaamii e kaaɗdi sabu giɗli kolliraaɗi gooto e men.
E nder majjere amen, min mbaɗdi feere, min mberli banndiiko amen e nder niɓɓere ɓunndu.
Ngam suuɗde golle amen, min ndokki baaba amen comci, ɓuuɓɗi ƴiiƴam fenaande.
Duuɓi seeɗa caggal ɗuum, heege mawnde addani en yahde Ejipt ngam ɗaɓɓude nguura.
Ko ɗoon min ngari e yeeso guwerneer doole, mo min nganndaa, ko kanko woni banndiraaɓe min tooñnoo.
Test amen cakkitiiɗo ko addude miñi amen tokooso, Binyamin, ko ɗum addani min feeñde e ko ɓenni e baaba amen ko Annabi Ya'qub.

trial.label: Hol ko wonnoo bonannde men adannde?
options: Fooɗtude baaba men e woppude miñi men
trial.answer: Fooɗtude baaba men e woppude miñi men

location.label: Hol huunde wonnoo hakkunde fenaande men?

outcome.label: Hol ko woni darnde daartol men ngol?
options: Min njaafaama, min kawriti e galle amen
outcome.answer: Min njaafaama, min kawriti e galle amen

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
